I just got some water spots all around our bathtub, sink, even our glassware after washing our laundry with my regular soap - what’s a quick solution?

When you find those stubborn white or light spots appearing in different places around or near water usage in or out home it usually is the sign for the hardness mineral content. Common household minerals such as calcare (also named limestone and also as the basis of limestone in your bathtub/shampoo or in glass are left over after using hard mineral filled soap or detergent and are washed through.

A very fast solution can be made from household supplies:

- White Tooth Brush 
– Lemon Juice 
Or Vinegarter or even Distiled white wine.

You can apply this solution directly or using white cloth on your spots to gently remove the minerals from your bathtub/shampo. You could use the same technique on
